name: Make change detection inputs explicit
statement: Represent component state with signals, inputs, computed values, or observable bindings and avoid mutation patterns that require manual or broad change-detection workarounds.
rationale: Explicit reactive state keeps updates predictable and supports efficient rendering. Quality Studio derives filtered and selected review state with signals rather than forcing change detection.

goodExample.code:
readonly rows = signal<Row[]>([]);
readonly visibleRows = computed(() => this.rows().filter(row => row.visible));

history.change: Initial change-detection rule grounded in Quality Studio's signal-based state.
